# Build your SBIR or STTR budget and see if the subawards break the rules

> Free SBIR and STTR proposal budget builder: personnel, fringe, MTDC indirect, subawards and fee in SF424 R&R lines, with checks on the small-business share of work, the STTR research-institution share and the fee ceiling. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
